purpose: Protect multi-intent understanding and route statistics for requests that mix a city explanation, nearby discovery, and a final multi-city route.

cases.input: Parti da Otranto, parlami di Otranto e dimmi cosa c'è intorno. Alla fine fammi un percorso tra Otranto, Gallipoli, Lecce e Nardò.

forbidden: Gallipoli must not replace Otranto as the informational subject
Duration must not be shown as 0 h

expect: route distance comes from lastRouteStats.distance after drawRoute completes
route travel time comes from lastRouteStats.duration after drawRoute completes
null requested duration remains null instead of becoming zero
actual total distance and travel time are included in Aracne's route response when available
the written answer remains visible while Aracne speaks
the assistant modal is not closed on speech start
after speech end the panels close and the map is revealed
the spider then weaves the already-computed route as a separate visual phase
